bodyHtml:
🪟 Windows 11 Specialists · Logan & Surrounds

Windows 11 Upgrade Logan. Even If Microsoft Says It Can't Be Done.

Let us upgrade your old computer to Windows 11, even if it says that it can't be done and you need a new computer. We have ways to install Windows 11 so you don't have to create more e-waste, especially if your computer is still working perfectly well.

Upgrade To Windows 11
✓ Bypass "Incompatible" Blocks
✓ Keep Your Existing PC
✓ Less E-Waste
✓ Onsite Or Remote
Why It Matters

Windows 10 Support Has Ended.

Microsoft ended free security updates for Windows 10 in October 2025. A computer running an unsupported operating system misses out on the security patches that protect it from new vulnerabilities, even if it otherwise still runs perfectly well. Upgrading to Windows 11 keeps you covered.

Our Approach

"Incompatible" Doesn't Always Mean Incompatible.

Microsoft's official compatibility checker rejects a lot of computers that are perfectly capable of running Windows 11 smoothly, usually over TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot requirements. We assess your hardware properly and, where it's safe and sensible to do so, install Windows 11 anyway, saving you the cost and waste of an unnecessary new computer.

What's Included

How We Get You Onto Windows 11.

🔍

Compatibility Assessment

We check your actual hardware, CPU, RAM, TPM and Secure Boot status, rather than trusting a blanket "not compatible" message.

🛠️

Compatibility Bypass

Where appropriate, we use recognised installation methods to get Windows 11 running on hardware Microsoft's checker rejects.

💾

Data Backup First

We back up your files before touching the operating system, so nothing is at risk during the upgrade. Ask about our data backup service for extra peace of mind.

✅

Post-Upgrade Setup

Drivers, updates and your everyday software checked and working properly once the upgrade is complete.

Less E-Waste, Lower Cost

A Working Computer Doesn't Belong In Landfill.

  • Still runs fine. If your computer handles everyday tasks well, replacing it purely over an OS compatibility flag is usually unnecessary.
  • Cheaper than a new PC. An upgrade costs a fraction of a new computer, and keeps your existing setup, files and software intact.
  • Better for the environment. Extending the life of working hardware means less electronic waste.
  • Stay protected. Get back onto a supported OS that still receives security updates.
Upgrade To Windows 11
Related Services

Before Or After Your Upgrade.

  • Want to avoid losing anything? Get data backup & transfer sorted before we touch the OS.
  • New Start menu not your thing? Our Windows de-bloat & customisation service brings back the classic feel.
  • Deeper OS problems too? See our full operating system install & repair service.
  • Software needs reinstalling after? We handle software install & setup too.
Frequently Asked Questions

Windows 11 Upgrade Questions, Answered.

My PC says it's "not compatible" with Windows 11, is that final?

Not necessarily. Microsoft's compatibility checker is strict about requirements like TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot, and rejects plenty of computers that can run Windows 11 fine in practice. We assess the actual hardware before deciding on the best path forward.

Will I lose my files during the upgrade?

We back up your files before making any changes, so your data is protected throughout the process regardless of which upgrade path we use.

Is it worth upgrading instead of buying a new computer?

If your computer still handles your day-to-day tasks well, an upgrade is usually far cheaper than a new machine and avoids unnecessary e-waste. We'll give you honest advice if your hardware genuinely is past its useful life.

Why does it matter that Windows 10 support has ended?

Once a Windows version stops receiving security updates, newly discovered vulnerabilities no longer get patched, leaving the system increasingly exposed over time, even if it otherwise runs normally.

Do you offer this service onsite or remotely?

Both. We can come to you, or connect securely and complete the upgrade remotely, depending on what suits you best.

Call Computer Repairs Logan and we'll tell you honestly whether your computer can be upgraded to Windows 11.
